data.name: HelpText
data.value:
CamaroDiag Windows J2534 Bridge — command line Run without arguments to open the graphical interface.
Usage: CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --help CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --list-ports CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --self-test CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --probe-drivers CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --j1979-legacy --adapter-index 0 --variant 2 --source 10 --confirm-legacy-profile --output legacy-vpw.json Read legacy emissions records for one documented response source. Variant 1=PWM, 2=VPW, 3=ISO9141, 4=KWP slow, 5=KWP fast. New JSON file required; no reset/control. CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --discover-connector COM5 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --inspect-connector-checkpoint checkpoint.bin CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --inspect-write-journal attempt.jsonl original-3MiB.bin CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --inspect-e39-image original-3MiB.bin CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --port 35001 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --port 35001 --memory-read-profile profile.json CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --port 35001 --allow-obd-clear CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-discover --host 192.0.2.10 --timeout-ms 1500 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-discover --listen true --listen-ipv6-ifindex 3 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-discover --multicast-ipv6-ifindex 3 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-discover --broadcast-ip 192.168.1.255 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-discover --host 192.0.2.10 --vin 1G1FA1RXXR0123456 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-status --host 192.0.2.10 --doip-version 3 CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-backup --host 192.0.2.10 --profile ecu-doip.json --archive backup.zip --confirm-read true CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-verify-backup --profile ecu-doip.json --archive backup.zip CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe --doip-exchange --host 192.0.2.10 --tester 0E80 --ecu 1234 --payload 22F190 --uds-p2-ms 100 --uds-p2-star-ms 2000
Examples: --self-test Software simulation only. No ECU or adapter. --probe-drivers Inspect installed Windows J2534 drivers; no ECU. --discover-connector COM5 USB serial CD/1 discovery only, isolated prototype. --inspect-write-journal attempt.jsonl [original-3MiB.bin] Inspect journal, saved physical blocks and optionally compare an original full BIN; no ECU write. --port 35001 Start the TLS-paired LAN bridge using a selected J2534 driver. It may check for app updates; never forward the LAN port to the Internet. --allow-obd-clear Explicitly enable OBD DTC clear on this local bridge run. The Android user must also confirm OK then YES. --doip-discover ISO 13400 gateway identity over UDP, not ECU authentication. --host unicast IPv4/IPv6, --broadcast-ip IPv4, --listen true passive; IPv6 ff02::1 uses an explicit --listen-ipv6-ifindex (passive) or --multicast-ipv6-ifindex (one ACTIVE UDP identity request). Replace interface 3 with the known link-local interface; never guess it. --vin or --eid filters discoveries; not both. Output includes version=0x02/0x03/0x04 as observed; verify gateway identity before selecting --doip-version. --doip-status Read entity status or --power-mode true over UDP. --doip-version 2, 3 or 4; version 255 is discovery-only. --doip-backup Two reads of the ECU region defined by the JSON --profile; --host, --archive ZIP, --confirm-read true required. TLS default; explicit --tls false; optional --certificate. --trace-file NEW.jsonl retains both acquisition passes. Optional --uds-p2-ms, --uds-p2-star-ms, --routing-activation-type, --routing-oem-data. --doip-verify-backup Offline ZIP/profile integrity check; no network access. --doip-exchange TCP/TLS UDS diagnostic exchange: user-selected --host, --tester, --ecu and hex --payload; --tls true selects validated TLS with no plaintext fallback; P2/P2* flags control deadlines. May change ECU state: require the correct authorized identity and explicit consent. --trace-file NEW.jsonl records UDP discovery/status and TCP/TLS diagnostic PDUs with UTC, TX/RX and endpoint; also available on discovery and status. Retained on failure. --sequence "22F190;1901FF" --expected-vin VIN sends 1–16 ordered commands on one verified session, TLS by default, stops at first error; interactive consent. --ecu-inventory 1234,1235 with --expected-vin VIN: verifies 1–16 explicit logical addresses instead of --ecu, read-only, no implicit scan; unverified is not absent. --obd-ecu-inventory 1234,1235: instead checks stable F802/F810; VIN verification is distinct from recognized OBDonUDS. --monitor-did F190 or --obd-monitor-did F40C with --expected-vin VIN, --samples 10, --interval-ms 1000. Read-only monitoring on one verified ECU, TLS by default. Optional --uds-p2-ms and --uds-p2-star-ms within total timeout. Samples are provisional until final identity verification. --monitor-dids 0xF40C:2,0xF40D:1 or --obd-monitor-dids 0xF40C:2,0xF40D:1: same timing options, one request per sample. --obd-identify --expected-vin VIN verifies a stable F802/F810 identity, even when OBDonUDS is not confirmed. Typed OBD reads with --expected-vin VIN verify F802/F810 before and after. --uds-dids 0xF40C:2,0xF40D:1 may add --obd-verified true; use actual ECU lengths. --uds-did F187 or --uds-scaling-did F40C with --expected-vin VIN verifies F190 before and after. Returns raw ECU bytes; no assumed scaling coefficients. Generic DTCs with the same verified VIN: --uds-dtc-mask 0xFF, --uds-dtc-count-mask 0xFF, --uds-snapshot 0x123456 --uds-snapshot-record 1, or --uds-extended-dtc 0x123456 --uds-extended-record 2. --uds-severity-count 0x80 or --uds-severity-list 0x80 with --uds-severity-status 0x08; --uds-severity-info 0x123456. All require --expected-vin VIN. --uds-fault-counters with --expected-vin VIN: signed FDC records. --uds-historical-dtc 0x0B/0x0C/0x0D/0x0E (choose one) with --expected-vin VIN: first/recent failed/confirmed DTC. --uds-supported-dtcs or --uds-snapshot-index with --expected-vin VIN lists supported codes or snapshot references. --uds-permanent-dtcs with --expected-vin VIN lists permanent UDS DTCs. --uds-memory 0x02 with --uds-memory-mask 0x08, or --uds-memory-snapshot 0x123456 / --uds-memory-extended 0x123456 with --uds-memory-record 1. Explicit --expected-vin required. --uds-stored-record 0x01 with --expected-vin VIN: individual stored record. --uds-all-stored-records F40C:2,F40D:1 with --expected-vin VIN: documented DID catalog, all records. --uds-stored-record 0x01 --stored-did-lengths F40D:1: decode one stored record, VIN required. --snapshot-did-lengths F40C:2,F40D:1 with --uds-snapshot or --obd-snapshot and explicit record: decoded snapshots. --extended-record-lengths 01:2,90:1 with --uds-extended-dtc or --obd-extended-dtc and explicit record: decoded extended data. --uds-memory-snapshot or --uds-memory-extended with memory, record and corresponding length catalog: decode selected memory. --uds-extended-record-support 0x01 or --uds-extended-record-data 0x01 with --uds-extended-record-size 2 (uniform documented byte length). Both require --expected-vin VIN. Legacy UDS only: --uds-mirror-mask 0x08 or --uds-mirror-count 0x08; --uds-mirror-extended 0x010203 with --uds-mirror-record 1; --uds-legacy-emissions-mask 0x08 or --uds-legacy-emissions-count 0x08. Explicit --expected-vin VIN required; no automatic fallback. No OEM security bypass, flash recovery or vehicle tests.
Use each option with the exact arguments described above. --help must be alone: mixing it with a programming command fails without contacting hardware. Raw UDS, flash and EEPROM operations are NOT enabled by this help. A simulated pass does not qualify the device on a real ECU. Linux x64/ARM64 bridge and matching CLI remain planned in issue #115.
